content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 reflects missing required authorization; retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable, and the valid codes and correct COB order provide no identified correction to make. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available and has paid 2 of 13 similar claims; although clean submissions paid 1 of 5, this claim has already received repeated CO-197 denials after submission. Appeal is the remaining substantive payer route before considering closure, and the denial does not establish that the full balance is patient responsibility.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
